title: Powerful Prayer to St. Anthony
text:
Blessed be God in his Angels and in his Saints.
O Holy St. Anthony,
gentle and powerful in your help,
your love for God and charity for his creatures
made you worthy when on earth
to possess miraculous powers.
Encouraged by this thought,
I implore you to obtain for me [mention your request].
The answer to my prayer may require a miracle;
even so, you are the Saint of Miracles.
O gentle and loving St. Anthony,
whose heart was ever full of human sympathy,
whisper my petition into the ears of the sweet Infant Jesus,
who loved to be folded in your arms,
and the gratitude of my heart will ever be yours.
Amen.

translation.latin:
Benedictus Deus in Angelis suis et in Sanctis suis.
O Sancte Antoni,
mitis et potens in auxilio tuo,
tuus amor erga Deum et caritas erga creaturas eius
te dignum fecerunt cum in terra esses
miraculos potestates possidere.
Hac cogitatione animatus,
imploro te ut obtineas mihi [mentio petitionem tuam].
Responsio ad meam orationem miraculum requirore potest;
attamen tu es Sanctus Miraculorum.
O mitis et amans Sancte Antoni,
cuius cor semper plenum fuit humanae sympathiae,
susurra petitionem meam in aures dulcis Pueri Iesu,
qui amabat in brachiis tuis complecti,
et gratitudo cordis mei semper tua erit.
Amen.

attribution: Traditional Novena Prayer to St. Anthony
notes: This powerful prayer to St. Anthony emphasizes his miraculous powers and his special relationship with the Infant Jesus. According to tradition, St. Anthony had a vision of the Christ Child, who came to rest in his arms. This prayer is often used in novenas for urgent or difficult requests.
description: Prayer emphasizing St. Anthony's miraculous powers and relationship with the Infant Jesus
